tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, code blocks.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Quiet tinted bands and table headers; never behind signal text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and input borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and fog (13:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on surface and surface-raised (5.7:1+).

tokens.name: elbe
tokens.usage: Brand navy: left half of the mark, headers, dark bands. Text on it is on-elbe.

tokens.name: on-elbe
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an elbe fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Pilot red: right half of the mark, the one thing that needs attention, error and danger; as text on surface or surface-raised (5:1+). Not the primary action (ADR 0140).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind signal text, selected rows.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Sparing accent for highlights, offsets and markers in diagrams; as text on surface (5:1+).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: State: healthy, committed, in sync. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: State: throttled, soft limit reached. Always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: State: error, hard limit, fenced. Same hue as signal, so it always carries an icon and a word.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, switches and toggle groups (3:1+ on surface, surface-raised and fog). `line` stays for hairlines and dividers.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action, active toggle and switch track: navy in light, a lifted blue in dark so it holds 3:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of a primary fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and inline actions; underlined in running text (4.7:1+ on surface, raised and fog).

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row bar, active tab indicator and selected marker; always with a word or shape as well.

tokens.name: selected-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a selected row.

tokens.name: danger-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of the solid danger button, used in the confirm dialog only.

tokens.name: on-danger-solid
tokens.usage: Text on danger-solid.

tokens.name: danger-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of danger-solid.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px gap in the page colour, then a 2px ring; never red, so focus is not mistaken for an error (4.7:1+ on surface, raised and fog).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls, log-segment pill height in graphics.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact rows, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding, page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups of cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, log-segment pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The mark's corners (at 64px) and large feature blocks only.
